conclusion: No additional blocker found in these three source files under the stated owner-commit premise.
ownerCommitPremise: Root withOwnedCommit must atomically admit/check the existing owner and run its final file move. It must not become an asynchronous unchecked callback. No separate owner/store/cache is constructed here.
observations: Producer removes exactly the three duplicate GCamera MotionPhoto expanded attributes while preserving modern Camera and legacy fields; ordered distinct/take and constructor admission are retained.
CancellationException is rethrown from EXIF handling. Ordinary EXIF failure checks coroutine activity and owner before the raw-JPEG fallback.
Bounded 32MiB still input and 200MiB streaming video copy are retained; staged output is same-directory, rechecked at commit and cleaned in finally.
RegGetValueW reads actual HKLM BIOS REG_SZ values, maps actual manufacturer/model, and writes the original four EXIF fields. No camera identity or gallery support is fabricated.
